in_sanskrit.name: Niral
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Shining, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Niral एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Niral is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir', which means 'shining' or 'radiant'. This name is often given to a baby boy born under the influence of the Sun, and it is believed to bestow upon the child the qualities of light, purity, and shine.

in_hindi.name: निरल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Absent of, not attached or bound to, free from
